capabilities: : Provide live syntax in edit mode
extras: Warning: Do not use this plugin if Prism.js or Obsidian officially supports Svelte syntax highlighting in the future.
intentEvidence: This plug-in provides syntax highlighting for the Svelte code block in Obsidian.
motivation: It started with the simple idea of adding an identifier for the Svelte syntax to the Prism object of Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian lacks native syntax highlighting support for Svelte code blocks.
summary: Provides syntax highlighting for Svelte code blocks in Obsidian, including live syntax highlighting in edit mode.
